column1: # Live RBAC route matrix: Phase 4 (sharing, read-only). Each step adds the rows of the behaviour it
# changes; a row of an earlier file whose answer a step changes is tagged superseded-by:p4 there.
# Columns: id, since, actor, method, path, body, expect, tags (see tests/rbac_matrix_live.sh).
# Every row here needs a share, so each is tagged sharing:on and SKIPs while RBAC_SHARING_ENABLED
# reads off. Run with the switch on and the instance policy enabled (sharing_policy.enabled by SQL
# on the shared instance), after step 4.4, whose seed (webapp/scripts/e2e-rbac-seed.mjs) provides:
#   viewer      a member account (rbac-viewer@e2e.local) holding a Read share, without Raw data,
#               on PSHARED
#   PSHARED_ID  a project owned by member_c, never PA (baseline rows expect member_b to get 404 on
#               PA), whose cypherfixGithubToken, graphqlAuthValue and one httpxCustomHeaders entry
#               hold the literal rbac-fake-share-secret-0001
# id
# ---- step 4.1: owner secrets withheld from every non-owner read ----
# The owner row proves the fake secret is really on the row, so the viewer's lacks= is not vacuous.
# The RoE downloads refuse a non-owner before any lookup (OQ-53), so no document needs seeding: the
# owner reaches the lookup (404, nothing uploaded), the viewer gets owner_only for both downloads,
# and the revision list (metadata) stays a read.
